The S1 muffler represents for SC-Project the perfect combination of lightness and performance without compromise. Its conical shape with taut and essential lines make the S1 silencer fascinating giving outburst to Your Ducati Panigale V4. Born from the experience of the racing department on the circuits of the WSBK Championship, the silencer has a Titanium body with Carbon end cap with a special sound-absorbing material that resists high temperatures. To make it unique and unmistakable our Technicians have used the best production processes: brackets and fittings welded with T.I.G. technology, the insert bushings in titanium made in CNC and lasered Logo. From the high and powerful sound the S1 silencer will make the Sound of Your Moto unique.

Slip-On muffler
Titanium link pipe with T.I.G. welding in section to guarantee the best performance
Springs and screws
SC-Project stickers
24 months SC-Project official warranty

Part Number - D26A-LT41T

A look with taut and decided lines will enrich Your Triumph Street Triple making it unique and exclusive. name: SC Project SC1-R Slip-On Exhaust for Aprilia RSV4 - Euro 5 - 2021-23
source_title: SC Project SC1-R Slip-On Exhaust for Aprilia RSV4 - Euro 5 - 2021-23
description: The new Aprilia RSV4 and Tuono V4 2021-2022 are clearly a benchmark in their category. The racing attitude of these bikes founds the perfect match…
source_description_html:
The new Aprilia RSV4 and Tuono V4 2021-2022 are clearly a benchmark in their category. The racing attitude of these bikes founds the perfect match with the SC1-R muffler, the top of SC-Project products range in terms of performance and technical solutions.

Developed during many years of close relationships between the Aprilia Racing and SC-Project Race departments, the SC1-R silencer is the maximum expression of power, quality and hi-tech solutions for the hypersport 1.100cc engines made in Noale. Thanks to the presence of an exclusive valve-system – developed by SC-Project for MotoGP and WSBK exhausts – this product is totally compliant with Euro 5 regulation.

Despite the severe restrictions of the Euro 5 compliance, this masterpiece of technology allows a sensible gain of torque (+1,4 Nm @ 7.500 rpm) and a consistent increase of power (+1,8 hp @ 13.000 rpm), but the benefit is distributed all around the range from 5.000 until 13.000 rpm. An important weight save of -20% (if compared to OEM exhaust), it fixes an absolut technical benchmark about homologated exhausts for these V4 engines. The final output of this exhaust is not just sound, but it is a real and vivid music for Aprilia lovers and owners.

The exit pipe obtained by hydroforming process and the Carbon Fiber end cap with rhomboidal and asymmetric shape, makes SC1-R silencer aggressive and sporty. For this application the lightweight outer body is available in Titanium. The weldings manufactured with T.I.G. technology in a protected environment, the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures and the insert bushings made in CNC machining, embellish the SC1-R muffler. The valve system is compatible with the original control unit and wiring, and this makes a plug-and-play installation. It is not necessary any ECU remapping . The kit includes a specific Carbon Fiber heat cover.

Slip-On muffler
Link pipe with exhaust valve
Carbon heat protection
Single seat bracket
Springs and screws
SC-Project stickers
24 months SC-Project official warranty
Homologation card

The slip-on mufflers have always represented the first step in terms of tuning process.

In the large products range of SC-Project, the S1 muffler has always represented the perfect combination of lightness, design and sound without compromise, especially for the racing applications developed for Aprilia RSV4 and Tuono V4.

The conical shape combined with essential lines and the elegant end cap in Carbon Fiber, make the S1 silencer a benchmark in terms of aesthetic and sound emotion. The absolute top quality finish of the outer sleeve in ultra-light Titanium, the T.I.G weldings handcrafted in protected environment, the accuracy of the Carbon Fiber end cap shape, are a pure joy for the look of the bike.

The kit comes with a specific support for a plug-and-play installation: ECU remapping is recommended in this case to optimize the engine delivery.

description: The slip-on mufflers have always represented the first step in terms of tuning process.
source_description_html:
The slip-on mufflers have always represented the first step in terms of tuning process.

In the large products range of SC-Project, the CR-T muffler has always represented the most iconic exhaust born for racing in MotoGP and Moto2 championships. The first World Title of SC-Project arrived with a CR-T exhaust developed and installed on the ART bike equipped with Aprilia V4 engine and Aleix Espargaro as rider, during the year 2013.

Many other World Titles arrived later for the CR-T exhaust in Moto2: the experience in MotoGP and Moto2 allowed to create a real icon in the crowded market of silencers, but no other exhaust is like the original CR-T by SC-Project. CR-T muffler has a 100% racing DNA, with aggressive look and sound without compromise, especially for the racing applications developed for Aprilia RSV4 and Tuono V4.

The absolute top quality finish of the outer sleeve (available in two options: ultra-light Titanium or Carbon Fiber), the T.I.G weldings handcrafted in protected environment, the round and generous muffler output, are a pure joy for the look of the bike and for all racing addicted. The version in Titanium comes with an high-quality laser engraved logo; the Carbon Fiber version comes with a precious aluminum riveted plate, the same used for MotoGP and Moto2 exhaust made by SC-Project Reparto Corse.

Another unbelievable experience comes when you turn on the V4 engine made in Noale: the strong and deep sound of SC-Project CR-T exhaust is an unforgettable experience.

For the installation of the CR-T slip-on it is necessary to remove the original valve exhaust: this silencer exhaust allows to save 3,3 Kg, which is an outstanding -60% weight save if compared to the original exhaust. The kit comes with a specific support for a plug-and-play installation: ECU remapping is recommended in this case to optimize the engine delivery.

Slip-On muffler
Titanium link pipe
Mounting bracket
Springs and screws
SC-Project stickers
24 months SC-Project official warranty

Part Number - A27A-T36CR, A27A-T36TR

From the iconic SC1-R, the R&D department of SC-Project has designed and developed the new SC1R-GT muffler. Specifically designed to meet the motorcycle segment Maxi Enduro and Crossover. A large volume exhaust, which integrates perfectly with the lines of Your Bike. The silencer was designed to last over time.

Our engineers have opted to use the best materials with advanced production processes. The T.I.G. welds, the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures and the insert bushings machined from solid by CNC machining embellish the SC1-R GT silencer.

The lightweight outer body in carbon fiber, the exit pipe obtained by hydroforming and the carbon fiber end cap allow a great saving in weight compared to the vast majority of the standard silencers.

The SC1-R GT slip-on has an immediately recognizable aggressive and sporty acoustics, while complying with Euro 5 requirements.

SC-Project wanted to make the silencer exclusive and inimitable with the logo on a metal plate. The entire system can be further improved with the addition of a carbon fiber protection made in the autoclave included in the kit.

Compatible with the BMW original bags.
Not compatible with the BMW R 1250 GS ADVENTURE version.

The Adventure muffler was created out of the need to bring SC-Project is technology and skills into the world of maxi-enduro and Sports-Tourer, is equipped with a titanium body enriched by laser marking with a mud effect that, together with the carbon end cap, recalls the nature of Adventure. The SC-Project R&D Department has developed an internal pre-chamber muffler with double output to optimise performance, reduce weight and give an unmistakable sound, even in the Euro5 approved version.
All the titanium and Aisi304 stainless steel parts are T.I.G. welded and the insert bushings are machined from solid by CNC machines and guarantee impeccable couplings.
SC-Project has further improved the dedicated and Euro5 approved Adventure muffler for the brand new BMW R 1250 GS.
An hyper-technological muffler, with the new internal pre-chamber and the double outlet, enriched by the renewed matte carbon fiber bottom with a Twill.
Our R&D department has dedicated a top-of-the-range silencer to the iconic "GS" to support the character of the German twin-cylinder. Updated look, full-bodied sound and even better performance for the BMW flagship. Carbon heat protection included in the kit

source_description_html:
The muffler SC1-R is created and developed by the experience of the SC-Project racing department in the most important World Competitions. A look with taut and decided lines will enrich Your Ducati Monster 821 making it unique and exclusive. The exit pipe obtained by hydroforming and the carbon fiber end cap from the rhomboidal asymmetric shape make inimitable the silencer SC1-R. The lightweight outer body is available in both Titanium and Carbon version. The weldings with T.I.G., the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures and the insert bushings made in CNC machining embellish the SC1-R silencer. In the version with Titanium body the R&D department of SC-Project wanted to make the SC1-R more elegant by imprinting the Logo by laser, without distorting the look, while in the Carbon version, on the silencer is applied an insert with the SC-Project logo as in the versions of our mufflers used in Competitions. In the kit is included the carbon heat protection.

The muffler SC1-R is created and developed by the experience of the SC-Project racing department in the most important World Competitions. A look with taut and decided lines will enrich Your Honda CBR1000RR making it unique and exclusive. The exit pipe obtained by hydroforming and the carbon fiber end cap from the rhomboidal asymmetric shape make inimitable the silencer SC1-R. The lightweight outer body is available in both Titanium and Carbon version. The weldings with T.I.G., the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures and the insert bushings made in CNC machining embellish the SC1-R silencer. In the version with Titanium body the R&D department of SC-Project wanted to make the SC1-R more elegant by imprinting the Logo by laser, without distorting the look, while in the Carbon version, on the silencer is riveted an insert with the SC-Project logo as in the versions of our mufflers used in Competitions. In the kit are incluede the titanium link pipe with T.I.G. welding in section to guarantee the best performance and the carbon heat protection.

The innovative SC1-R, a benchmark for the Superbike World Championship, is available in titanium or carbon body versions.
The SC1-R is a hi-tech muffler that came about from the need to offer the public a product with a racing soul, but which, thanks to work by the R&D Department creating a Euro4 approved version, allows it to be used on the road fitted on many motorcycles.

The innovative SC1-R, a benchmark for the Superbike World Championship, is available in titanium or carbon body versions.
The SC1-R is a hi-tech muffler that came about from the need to offer the public a product with a racing soul, but which, thanks to work by the R&D Department creating a Euro4approved version, allows it to be used on the road fitted on many motorcycles.
The asymmetric, angular and clean rhomboidal shape, together with the matt carbon fibre end cap, recalls the sporting spirit of the SC1-R confirming it as the ideal muffler for the latest super sports bikes.

source_description_html:
The muffler SC1-R is created and developed by the experience of the SC-Project racing department in the most important World Competitions. A look with taut and decided lines will enrich Your Yamaha YZF R1 making it unique and exclusive. The exit pipe obtained by hydroforming and the carbon fiber end cap from the rhomboidal asymmetric shape make inimitable the silencer SC1-R. The lightweight outer body is available in both Titanium and Carbon version. The weldings with T.I.G., the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures and the insert bushings made in CNC machining embellish the SC1-R silencer. In the version with Titanium body the R&D department of SC-Project wanted to make the SC1-R more elegant by imprinting the Logo by laser, without distorting the look, while in the Carbon version, on the silencer is riveted an insert with the SC-Project logo as in the versions of our mufflers used in Competitions. In the kit are included the carbon heat protection and the Y 1-2 full titanium de-cat link pipe to guarantee the best performance.

Slip-On muffler
Y 1-2 full titanium de-cat link pipe
Carbon heat protection
Single seat bracket
Springs and screws

source_description_html:
The racing attitude of Honda CBR1000RR-R founds the perfect match with the SC1-R muffler, the top of SC-Project products range in terms of performance and technical solutions. 

The SC1-R silencer is the maximum expression of power, quality and hi-tech solutions for the hypersport bikes: with a very aggressive and sporty look, this slip-on allows the removal of OEM valve exhaust thanks to the titanium racing link pipe provided with the kit. This solution allows a consistent weight reduction if compared to the original exhaust and allows the noise level to be accepted for race track use: 101dB @5500 rpm with dB-killer installed / 105dB @5500 rpm without dB-killer. For race use, the dB-killer is removable: the exit pipe obtained by hydroforming process and the carbon fiber end cap with rhomboidal and asymmetric shape, makes the SC1-R the best slip-on muffler for this bike. 

For this application the lightweight outer body is available in two options: titanium or carbon fiber. The weldings manufactured with TIG technology in protected environment, the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures and the insert bushings made in CNC machining, embellish the SC1-R muffler. The kit includes a specific carbon fiber heat protection. The final output of this exhaust is not just sound, but it is a real deep and sensational racing music for Honda CBR1000RR-R owners.

source_description_html:
The SC-Project full system exhaust is the direct result of the research, development and design work carried out by the R&D department together with the major MotoGP and SBK World Championship Teams.
SC-Project, with the aim of improving performance and aesthetics of the Your Honda CBR650R has created a complete unit designed to house the original lambda probe, showcases first-class technical solutions: the use of CNC machined bushings turned from solid allow the exhaust system impeccable coupling that make fitting easier and improve system performance; the implementation of a lighter system ensures better bike rideability. The production of pipes of variable dimensions guarantees a marked increase in performance both in terms of torque and maximum power through the entire bend.

The muffler SC1-R is created and developed by the experience of the SC-Project racing department in the most important World Competitions. A look with taut and decided lines will enrich Your Honda CBR650R making it unique and exclusive. The exit pipe obtained by hydroforming and the carbon fiber end cap from the rhomboidal asymmetric shape make inimitable the silencer SC1-R. The lightweight outer body is available in both Titanium and Carbon version. The weldings with T.I.G., the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures and the insert bushings made in CNC machining embellish the SC1-R silencer. In the version with Titanium body the R&D department of SC-Project wanted to make the SC1-R more elegant by imprinting the Logo by laser, without distorting the look, while in the Carbon version, on the silencer is applied an insert with the SC-Project logo as in the versions of our mufflers used in Competitions.

The SC-Project full system exhaust is the direct result of the research, development and design work carried out by the R&D department for the Trophy Aprilia Racing RS 660.

The implementation of a lighter system ensures better bike rideability. The production of pipes of variable dimensions guarantees a marked increase in performance both in terms of torque and maximum power through the entire bend. The removal of the original catalyst means a significant operating temperature reduction as well as a dark and deep sound, the real SC-Project hallmark.

The muffler SC1-R is created and developed by the experience of the SC-Project racing department in the most important World Competitions. A look with taut and decided lines will enrich Your BMW S 1000 XR making it unique and exclusive. The exit pipe obtained by hydroforming and the carbon fiber end cap from the rhomboidal asymmetric shape make inimitable the silencer SC1-R. The lightweight outer body is available in Carbon version. The weldings with T.I.G., the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures and the insert bushings made in CNC machining embellish the SC1-R silencer. In the version Carbon on the silencer is applied an insert with the SC-Project logo as in the versions of our mufflers used in Competitions.

source_description_html:
This S1 full exhaust system for the new Triumph Street Triple 765 R - RS is the result of SC-Project experience in the Moto2 World Championship.

Everything has been developed to offer the best performance together with a great improvement of the agility of the Triumph Street Triple 765 R - RS, thanks to an outstanding weight reduction of over 55% if compared to the original exhaust system and an incredible performance gain of 6.0 hp at 10500 rpm and 4.0 Nm at 10500 rpm.

The S1 silencer shape donates an aggressive yet elegant look to the full system and is enriched by an exclusive riveted aluminium plate with SC-Project logo.

As soon as you start the engine on your Triumph Street Triple, the conical shape will reward you with strong and deep notes, true SC-Project signature sound. 

To guarantee you the best customization possible, we have equipped the muffler with a removable baffle. This solution will give you the choice between a loud (but acceptable) 110 dB with dB-killer installed and a louder sound of 114 dB without dB-killer.

The exhaust system is crafted entirely with AISI 304 Stainless Steel to ensure optimal resistance and durability. It is manufactured using state-of-the-art technologies, including handcrafted TIG welds and internal bushings CNC machined from solid block, exactly like every SC-Project product.

The installation is 100% plug and play.

Together with this kit, the purchase of SC-Project ECR (Electronic Catalytic Remover) is strongly recommended. With the removal of the catalytic converter, the motorcycle’s ECU could generate an error. This device has been developed by SC-Project to correctly manage the removal of the catalytic converter. Extremely easy to install, it needs to be connected to the OBD socket and it will automatically manage the error, safely restoring the correct functionality of the on-board electronic system. You will find it in the related products section.

The Kawasaki ZX-4R - RR stands at the peak of its category, thanks to the rpms-hungry 4 cylinders engine.

To allow you to enjoy every high-rev note of this innovative engine in full compliance with Euro 5 regulation, SC-Project developed this specific version of the SC1-S silencer.

Manufactured using high grade titanium, the muffler enhances the agility of the little Ninja thanks to a massive weight reduction of more than -50% (-2.2 kg if compared to the OEM silencer) while upgrading the performance of the engine with a stable improvement of power and torque delivery in the low and mid range.

All the components of the SC1-S are welded with TIG technology (in protected environment) and the internal bushings are CNC machined from solid block: excellent couplings and top quality materials are necessary to offer the best durability, quality and performance.

The silencer’s body is enriched by an exclusive aluminium plate with SC-Project logo, exactly as the exhaust systems of SC-Project’s Reparto Corse.

Installation is 100% plug and play and ECU remapping is not necessary.

name: SC Project CR-T Full Exhaust System Stainless For Aprilia RS 660 20-22
source_title: SC Project CR-T Full Exhaust System Stainless For Aprilia RS 660 20-22
description: The full-system is the result of the research, development and design work started by the SC-Project R&D department for the Aprilia Racing RS 660 Trophy.
source_description_html:
The full-system is the result of the research, development and design work started by the SC-Project R&D department for the Aprilia Racing RS 660 Trophy.

The complete exhaust system, designed for the Aprilia RS 660, is compatible with the original lambda probe and is built with top-level technical solutions such as TIG welding performed in a controlled environment and the use of CNC machined billet bushings. These give the exhaust system perfect couplings that make it easier to assemble and improve performance. The lightening of the kit guarantees better handling of the bike. The variable size headers, made of AISI 304 stainless steel, ensure a strong performance increase both in terms of torque and maximum power throughout the curve. The removal of the original catalyst allows an important reduction of the operating temperature.

The use of the SC1-R muffler, available in both titanium and carbon, gives a deep and dark sound to this bike.

Kit contents

Slip-On muffler
Full Stainless steel AISI 304 Exhaust System 2-1
Carbon heat protection
Single seat bracket
Springs and screws
SC-Project stickers
24 months SC-Project official warranty

source_description_html:
The full-system SC-Project "Trofeo" is the direct result of the development project for the Aprilia RS660 track version, arranged by our R&D department to create the "ready to race" version in cooperation with Aprilia Racing department - project included in the Factory Works program.

The SC-Project “Trofeo” exhaust was developed on Aprilia Factory demand, for the ambitious trophy program of the Italian brand for 250 Sport Production and RS660 classes.

The full-system is the result of the research, development and design work started by the SC-Project R&D department for the Aprilia Racing RS 660 Trophy. The complete exhaust system, designed for the Aprilia RS 660, is compatible with the original lambda probe and is built with top-level technical solutions such as TIG welding performed in a controlled environment and the use of CNC machined billet bushings. These give the exhaust system perfect couplings that make it easier to assemble and improve performance. The lightening of the kit guarantees better handling of the bike. The variable size headers, made of titanium, ensure a strong performance increase both in terms of torque and maximum power throughout the curve. The removal of the original catalyst allows an important reduction of the operating temperature.

The use of the SC1-R muffler, available in both titanium and carbon, gives a deep and dark sound to this bike.

Kit contents

Slip-On muffler
Full Titanium Exhaust System 2-1
Single seat bracket
Springs and screws
SC-Project stickers
24 months SC-Project official warranty

In order not to waive the performance and the unmistakable sound of the “Trofeo” full-system with SC1-R silencer, the SC-Project R&D department has developed the EURO 5 approved system for your Aprilia RS 660.
The full system is equipped with a pre-chamber with a solid design, in line with the unique style of this Aprilia. Thanks to the catalyst inserted in the pre-chamber, it is possible to obtain the best performance always in compliance with the European regulations for street use.

Available with SC1-R silencer in titanium or carbon fiber , the product has been made with the same accuracy and technical features as the racing system: T.I.G. welding performed in a controlled environment and bushings CNC machined from solid that guarantee perfect couplings. Made entirely of AISI 304 stainless steel, it was designed for the use of original lambda probes.

The kit is enriched with a dedicated carbon fiber protection and single-seat bracket in black anodized aluminum.

Kit contents

Slip-On muffler
Full Stainless steel AISI 304 Exhaust System 2-1
Carbon heat protection
Single seat bracket
Springs and screws
SC-Project stickers
24 months SC-Project official warranty
Homologation card

source_title: SC Project Rally Raid Slip-On Exhaust For Triumph Tiger 900 2020-23
description: Clearly inspired by dusty deserts, the Rally Raid muffler is the result of SC-Project experience during the most extreme off-road competitions. The materials used, the…
source_description_html:
Clearly inspired by dusty deserts, the Rally Raid muffler is the result of SC-Project experience during the most extreme off-road competitions. The materials used, the production process, the global manufacturing accuracy and even the design and the volume of this silencer, has been calculated and tested to be a real benchmark for the multi-purpose bikes like Triumph Tiger 900.

The Rally Raid silencer is totally manufactured with high quality titanium with a very typical and aggressive end cap which recalls the intense off-road use. All the technical solutions applied on this product have been tested all over the world during very long distance trips in the most severe conditions, both on road and especially off-road use. All the components are welded with TIG technology (in protected environment) and the internal bushings are CNC machined from solid block: excellent couplings, top quality materials and high technology production processes are necessary to offer the best durability, quality and performance.

Everything has been developed to offer a superbe sound experience, for this application the muffler comes with removable db-killer: the noise level with db-killer is 93 dB / w-out db-killer is 97 dB @ 4375 rpm. The sound of the 3-cylinders engine combined with SC-Project voice will be simply exciting.

For the Triumph Tiger 900, the Rally Raid muffler is provided with allows to save weight (-57% if compared to the OEM exhaust) and to get a maximum gain of 2.1 hp and 2.5 Nm of torque @ 8800 rpm, together with a stable improvement of power and torque delivery in the low and mid range.

The installation is plug-and-play, ECU remapping is not necessary. This silencer is suitable with OEM side cases and comes with a precious carbon fiber heat shield.

Slip-On muffler
Carbon fiber heat protection
Springs and screws
SC-Project stickers
24 months SC-Project official warranty

Part Number - T27A-100T

source_description_html:
The silencer X-Plorer II is the answer of the SC-Project R&D department for people who want elegance and refinement even for a maxi-enduro bike like Triumph Tiger 900. Available in titanium or carbon fiber option, SC-Project developed this streamlined exhaust in full compliance with Euro-5 regulations. The carbon fiber end cap is perfectly in harmony with the shape of the muffler body.

The X-Plorer II muffler is manufactured with high quality titanium and using all technical solutions tested all over the world during very long distance travels in the most severe conditions, both on road and especially off-road use. All the components in titanium and AISI 304 stainless steel are welded with TIG technology (in protected environment) and the internal bushings are CNC machined from solid block: excellent couplings, top quality materials and high technology production processes are necessary to offer the best durability, quality and performance.

On the Triumph Tiger 900, the X-Plorer II muffler allows a consistent weight reduction (-50% if compared to the OEM exhaust) and to get a maximum gain of 1.1 hp and 1.3 Nm of torque @ 6250 rpm, together with a stable improvement of power and torque delivery in the low and mid range. Everything has been developed to offer a superbe sound experience, in full compliance with Euro-5 regulations.

The installation is plug-and-play, ECU remapping is not necessary. This silencer is suitable with OEM side cases and comes with a precious carbon fiber heat shield.

Options available: muffler outer sleeve in titanium or carbon fiber.

source_description_html:
Description

The SC-Project full system exhaust is the direct result of the research, development and design work carried out by the R&D department together with the major MotoGP and SBK World Championship Teams.
SC-Project, with the aim of improving performance and aesthetics of the Your Honda CB650F has created a complete unit designed to house the original lambda probe, showcases first-class technical solutions: the use of CNC machined bushings turned from solid allow the exhaust system impeccable coupling that make fitting easier and improve system performance; the implementation of a lighter system ensures better bike rideability. The production of pipes of variable dimensions guarantees a marked increase in performance both in terms of torque and maximum power through the entire bend.
The muffler SC1-R is created and developed by the experience of the SC-Project racing department in the most important World Competitions. A look with taut and decided lines will enrich Your Honda CB650F making it unique and exclusive. The exit pipe obtained by hydroforming and the carbon fiber end cap from the rhomboidal asymmetric shape make inimitable the silencer SC1-R. The lightweight outer body is available in both Titanium and Carbon version. The weldings with T.I.G., the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures and the insert bushings made in CNC machining embellish the SC1-R silencer. In the version with Titanium body the R&D department of SC-Project wanted to make the SC1-R more elegant by imprinting the Logo by laser, without distorting the look, while in the Carbon version, on the silencer is applied an insert with the SC-Project logo as in the versions of our mufflers used in Competitions.

Kit contents

Full exhaust system 4-1 with steel AISI 304 pipes
Slip-On muffler
Springs and screws
SC-Project stickers
24 months SC-Project official warranty
Homologation card

source_description_html:
The muffler SC1-R is created and developed by the experience of the SC-Project racing department in the most important World Competitions. A look with taut and decided lines will enrich Your Kawasaki Ninja ZX-10R making it unique and exclusive. The exit pipe obtained by hydroforming and the carbon fiber end cap from the rhomboidal asymmetric shape make inimitable the silencer SC1-R. The lightweight outer body is available in Carbon version. The weldings with T.I.G., the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures and the insert bushings made in CNC machining embellish the SC1-R silencer. In the version Carbon on the silencer is applied an insert with the SC-Project logo as in the versions of our mufflers used in Competitions. In the kit are included the full titanium link pipe and the carbon heat protection.

The exit pipe obtained by hydroforming and the carbon fiber end cap from the rhomboidal asymmetric shape make inimitable the silencer SC1-R. The lightweight outer body is available in both Titanium version. The weldings with T.I.G., the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures and the insert bushings made in CNC machining embellish the SC1-R silencer. In the version with Titanium body the R&D department of SC-Project wanted to make the SC1-R more elegant by imprinting the Logo by laser, without distorting the look. In the kit are included the full titanium link pipe and the carbon heat protection.

The SC1-R muffler represents the maximum technological expression that can be mounted on BMW F900R and XR. Derived directly from the SBK, extreme performance and shapes made especially for your BMW. Its outlet is obtained by hydroforming in titanium, its carbon end cap is made in an autoclave and available with an external body in titanium or carbon. The welds of the bracket and the fitting are produced with T.I.G. technology, the sound-absorbing material is designed to withstand extremely high temperatures. The sound is unique. Together with the silencer, a black pre-chamber (obtained with ceramic paints resistant to very high temperatures) is provided, specifically designed to reduce the shape of the muffler as much as possible, and made to fit in the best way with the design of the motorcycle. The muffler is EURO5 approved. It comes with a specific carbon protection made in an autoclave. The muffler has a system that allows installation in two different positions: high, for a sport position, or low if the original right side bag is used. This adjustment is possible in a very simple and fast way.

source_description_html:
SC-Project has used all the experience gained in the Moto2 World Championship to create the SC1-S full exhaust system, enhancing the performance, the agility and the spectacular sound of one of the best 3 cylinders bikes in the world. 

Everything has been developed to offer the best performance together with a great improvement of the agility of the Triumph Street Triple 765 R - RS, thanks to an outstanding weight reduction of over 50% (if compared to the OEM exhaust system) and an incredible performance gain of 5.0 hp at 10500 rpm and 3.5 Nm at 10500 rpm (performance data are registered without db-killer).

To grant you the opportunity to fully enjoy your Triumph Street Triple 765 R - RS, the silencer is equipped with a removable baffle; this will give you the choice between a loud (but acceptable) 104 dB with dB-killer in and a louder 108 dB without dB-killer.

Everything has been developed to offer the best performance together with a great improvement of the agility of the Triumph Street Triple 765, thanks to an outstanding weight reduction of 50% (if compared to the OEM exhaust system) and an incredible performance gain of 5.0 hp at 10500 rpm and 3.5 Nm at 10500 rpm (performance data are registered without db-killer).

To grant you the opportunity to fully enjoy your Triumph Street Triple 765, the silencer is equipped with a removable baffle; this will give you the choice between a loud (but acceptable) 104 dB with dB-killer in and a louder 108 dB without dB-killer.

The headers are manufactured with AISI 304 Stainless Steel to guarantee the best resistance and durability and the SC1-S muffler is available in two different options, granting the best customisation possible: titanium or carbon fibre. The elegance of the SC1-S muffler body combined with the sporty design and asymmetric rhomboidal shape of the outlet, is an outstanding balance in terms of design and dimensions.

Thanks to the high grade titanium muffler’s body, this product provides an incredible weight reduction of over 60% (if compared to OEM exhaust), while upgrading the performance of the engine by a maximum 1,9 hp at 8800 rpm and 0,8 Nm of torque at 7400 rpm, together with a stable improvement of power and torque delivery in the low and mid range.

The development of this exhaust has been completed with SC-Project typical signature: the sound. The voice of the 4 cylinder will be emphasised with deep and aggressive tones in full compliance with Euro 5+ regulation.

Everything about this silencer has been developed to offer the highest quality and performance experience: the best materials with advanced production processes like handcrafted TIG weldings, the asymmetrical outlet obtained with hydroforming technology and finally the unique and sporty carbon fibre end cap.

To further enhance the aggressive aesthetics of the Z1100, the muffler body is completed with a laser-etched SC-Project logo, perfectly integrated with the bike’s unique lines.

Installation is plug-and-play, with no need for ECU remapping.

description: SC-Project used all the experience gained during the long term collaboration with Aprilia Racing to develop this full exhaust system with S1 muffler for the…
source_description_html:
SC-Project used all the experience gained during the long term collaboration with Aprilia Racing to develop this full exhaust system with S1 muffler for the new Aprilia RS 457.

Everything has been developed to offer the best performance together with a great improvement of the agility of the Aprilia RS 457, thanks to an outstanding weight reduction of over 30% (if compared to the OEM exhaust system) and an incredible performance gain of 2.5 hp at 7200 rpm and 2.2 Nm at 7200 rpm (performance data are registered without dB-killer).

The S1 silencer shape, together with the spectacular carbon fibre end can, donates an aggressive yet elegant look to the full system and is enriched by an exclusive riveted aluminium plate with SC-Project logo.

As soon as you start the engine on your Aprilia RS 457, the conical shape will reward you with strong and deep notes, true SC-Project signature sound. 

To guarantee you the best customization possible, we have equipped the muffler with a removable baffle. This solution will give you the choice between a loud (but acceptable) 104 dB at 5500 rpm with dB-killer installed and a louder sound of 112 dB at 5500 rpm without dB-killer.

The exhaust system is crafted entirely with AISI 304 Stainless Steel to ensure optimal resistance and durability. It is manufactured using state-of-the-art technologies, including handcrafted TIG welds, exactly like every SC-Project product.

Included in the precious package, you will find the ECR (Electronic Catalytic Remover). From the experience gained from the most extreme rally competitions in the world, SC-Project developed the new Rally-X muffler: this silencer has been engineered to unlock the true offroad spirit of the BMW R 1300 GS.

The Rally-X comes in a short, compact and very aggressive version (250 mm length).

The silencer body is totally new and manufactured using high quality titanium with a slightly conical shape that enlightens the aerodynamic design of the BMW R 1300 GS and it perfectly matches the OEM heat shield. The aggressive end cap has a generous diameter output that recalls the off-road racing world.

The materials used, the production process, the global manufacturing accuracy and even the design and the volume of this silencer, has been calculated and tested to be a real bench mark in terms of durability for the multi-purpose bikes like the BMW R 1300 GS, in full compliance with Euro 5+ regulations.

All the technical solutions applied on this product have been tested all over the world during very long distance trips in the most several conditions, both on road and especially off road use. All the components are welded with TIG technology (in protected environment) and the internal bushings are CNC machined from solid block. Excellent couplings, top quality materials and high technology production processes are necessary to offer the best durability, quality and a superbe sound experience, in full compliance with Euro 5+ regulations.

The Rally-X silencer is enriched by an exclusive aluminium plate with the SC-Project logo, exactly as the exhaust systems of SC-Project Reparto Corse.
The installation is plug and play, ECU remapping is not necessary and this silencer is suitable with OEM side cases.

source_description_html:
The SC-Project full system exhaust is the direct result of the research, development and design work carried out by the R&D department together with the major MotoGP and SBK World Championship Teams. SC-Project, with the aim of improving performance and aesthetics of the Your Kawasaki Versys 650 has created a complete unit designed to house the original lambda probe, showcases first-class technical solutions: the use of CNC machined bushings turned from solid allow the exhaust system impeccable coupling that make fitting easier and improve system performance; the implementation of a lighter system ensures better bike rideability. The production of pipes of variable dimensions guarantees a marked increase in performance both in terms of torque and maximum power through the entire bend.

The innovative SC1-R GT, a benchmark for the Superbike World Championship, is available in titanium body. The SC1-R GT is a hi-tech muffler that came about from the need to offer the public a product with a racing soul, but which, thanks to work by the R&D Department creating a Euro4 approved version, allows it to be used on the road fitted on many motorcycles. The asymmetric, angular and clean rhomboidal shape, together with the carbon fibre end cap, recalls the sporting spirit of the SC1-R GT confirming it as the ideal muffler for the latest bikes. The SC1-R GT muffler boasts sophisticated technical solutions such as bracket and fitting welds with T.I.G. technology, sound-absorbing material designed to withstand the very high temperatures and exhaust gas pressures of racing motorcycles, and the titanium insert bushings machined from solid by CNC machines, which guarantee impeccable couplings.

The SC-Project full system exhaust is the direct result of the research, development and design work carried out by the R&D department together with the major MotoGP and SBK World Championship Teams. SC-Project, with the aim of improving performance and aesthetics of the Your Kawasaki Ninja 650 has created a complete unit designed to house the original lambda probe, showcases first-class technical solutions: the use of CNC machined bushings turned from solid allow the exhaust system impeccable coupling that make fitting easier and improve system performance; the implementation of a lighter system ensures better bike rideability. The production of pipes of variable dimensions guarantees a marked increase in performance both in terms of torque and maximum power through the entire bend.

The innovative SC1-R GT, a benchmark for the Superbike World Championship, is available in titanium body. The SC1-R GT is a hi-tech muffler that came about from the need to offer the public a product with a racing soul, but which, thanks to work by the R&D Department creating a Euro4 approved version, allows it to be used on the road fitted on many motorcycles. The asymmetric, angular and clean rhomboidal shape, together with the carbon fibre end cap, recalls the sporting spirit of the SC1-R GT confirming it as the ideal muffler for the latest bikes. source_description_html:
The R&D department of SC-Project has tested and developed the SC1-R muffler as a solution to join the aggressive design of big sport-tourer bikes like Kawasaki Ninja 1000SX.

Everything about this silencer has been made to offer the highest quality and performance experience: the best materials with advanced production process like the TIG weldings manufactured in protected environment, the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures, the internal bushings CNC machined from solid block, the exit pipe obtained by hydroforming technology and finally the unique and sporty carbon fiber end cap. The SC1-R silencer is a real piece of art, technology and design 100% Made in Italy. 

This silencer represents the top quality level of SC-Project products range and it has been projected and manufactured for resisting long distance use.

For the Kawasaki Ninja 1000SX, this exhaust comes in Euro 4 compliant version: everything has been developed to offer a superb sound experience in full compliance for street legal use.

The SC1-R muffler allows a huge weight reduction (-40% if compared to the OEM exhaust) and to gain a maximum of +1.2 hp and +1.0 Nm of torque at 8500 rpm, with a constant improvement of performance delivery.

The installation is plug&play, ECU remapping is not necessary. 

This silencer is suitable with OEM side cases.

Options available: titanium color or ceramic matt-black color.

source_description_html:
The SC-Project full system exhaust is the direct result of the research, development and design work carried out by the R&D department together with the major MotoGP and SBK World Championship Teams.
SC-Project, with the aim of improving performance and aesthetics of the Your Honda CBR650R has created a complete unit designed to house the original lambda probe, showcases first-class technical solutions: the use of CNC machined bushings turned from solid allow the exhaust system impeccable coupling that make fitting easier and improve system performance; the implementation of a lighter system ensures better bike rideability. The production of pipes of variable dimensions guarantees a marked increase in performance both in terms of torque and maximum power through the entire bend.

The muffler SC1-R is created and developed by the experience of the SC-Project racing department in the most important World Competitions. A look with taut and decided lines will enrich Your Honda CBR650R making it unique and exclusive. The exit pipe obtained by hydroforming and the carbon fiber end cap from the rhomboidal asymmetric shape make inimitable the silencer SC1-R. The lightweight outer body is available in both Titanium and Carbon version. The weldings with T.I.G., the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures and the insert bushings made in CNC machining embellish the SC1-R silencer. In the version with Titanium body the R&D department of SC-Project wanted to make the SC1-R more elegant by imprinting the Logo by laser, without distorting the look, while in the Carbon version, on the silencer is applied an insert with the SC-Project logo as in the versions of our mufflers used in Competitions.

Full exhaust system 4-1 with steel AISI 304 pipes
Slip-On muffler
Springs and screws

A large volume exhaust, which integrates perfectly with the lines of Your Bike. The silencer was designed to last over time.

The SC1-R GT slip-on has an immediately recognizable aggressive and sporty acoustics, while complying with Euro 4 requirements.

SC-Project wanted to make the silencer exclusive and inimitable with the logo on a metal plate. The entire system can be further improved with the addition of a carbon fiber protection made in the autoclave included in the kit.

Compatible with the BMW original bags.

Not compatible with the BMW R 1250 GS ADVENTURE version.

source_title: SC Project SC1-R Slip-On Exhaust For Aprilia RSV4 350mm - 2021-23
description: The new Aprilia RSV4 and Tuono V4 2021-2022 are clearly a benchmark in their category. The racing attitude of these bikes founds the perfect match…
source_description_html:
The new Aprilia RSV4 and Tuono V4 2021-2022 are clearly a benchmark in their category. The racing attitude of these bikes founds the perfect match with the SC1-R muffler, the top of SC-Project products range in terms of performance and technical solutions.

Developed during many years of close relationships between the Aprilia Racing and SC-Project Race Departments, the SC1-R silencer is the maximum expression of power, quality and hi-tech solutions for the hypersport 1.100cc engines made in Noale. Developed by SC-Project for Aprilia (SBK and STK configuration), this silencer comes in long configuration 350 mm length for a very aggressive and sporty look and allows the removal of OEM valve exhaust thanks to the full Titanium racing link pipe provided with the kit.

This solution allows a consistent weight reduction of -43% if compared to the original exhaust, this masterpiece of technology allows the noise level to be accepted for race track use: 102 dB @ 6500 rpm with dB-killer installed / 104 dB @ 6500 rpm w-out dB-killer installed. For race use, the dB-killer is removable: the exit pipe obtained by hydroforming process and the Carbon Fiber end cap with rhomboidal and asymmetric shape, makes the SC1-R the best slip-on muffler for this bike. For this application the lightweight outer body is available in two options: Titanium or Carbon Fiber.

The weldings manufactured with T.I.G. technology in a protected environment, the sound-absorbing material resistant to very high temperatures and the insert bushings made in CNC machining, embellish the SC1-R muffler. This makes a plug-and-play installation: ECU remapping is recommended in this case to optimize the engine delivery. The kit includes a specific Carbon Fiber heat cover and the racing bracket to remove passenger footpeg, together with the full Titanium link pipe.

Finally the impressive maximum gain of torque: +5,1 Nm @ 7700 rpm and a consistent increase of power (+5,8 hp @ 7700 rpm) with the baffle installed. W-out the baffle the maximum torque gain is +6,5 Nm @ 8000 rpm while the power gain is +7,0 hp @ 8000 rpm. This benefit is distributed and usable all around the range from 3.000 until 13.000 rpm. The final output of this exhaust is not just sound, but it is a real deep and sensational racing music for Aprilia lovers and owners.

Slip-On muffler
Link pipe
Carbon heat protection
Single seat bracket
Springs and screws
SC-Project stickers
24 months SC-Project official warranty

The kit includes a specific Carbon Fiber heat cover and the racing bracket to remove passenger footpeg, together with the mentioned valve exhaust in Titanium – derived from MotoGP factory teams - and a full Titanium link pipe.

Finally the impressive maximum gain of torque: +6,5 Nm @ 7700 rpm and a consistent increase of power (+7,2 hp @ 7700 rpm) with the baffle installed. W-out the baffle the maximum torque gain is +8,0 Nm @ 8000 rpm while the power gain is +9,1 hp @8000 rpm. Anyway the benefit is distributed and usable all around the range from 3.000 until 13.000 rpm.

The final output of this exhaust is not just sound, but it is a real deep and sensational racing music for Aprilia lovers and owners.
